ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white ventral surface to low-intensity black trailing edges and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous region across the central fluke; irregular low-intensity black band along the trailing edge (approx. 5-10 pixels wide); vertical low-intensity black/grey patch at the insertion point (peduncle area).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% into the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; distinct high-amplitude peaks on the right lobe near the distal tip; more uniform, lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips; trailing edge terminates in sharp, upward-sweeping distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured barnacles localized at both the left and right distal tips; multiple circular, low-intensity recessed scars (approx. 10-15 units) distributed across the white ventral field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single dark linear disruption visible on the mid-left lobe; smaller diagonal linear marking on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface (likely cookie-cutter shark scars); small dark/reddish lesions localized near the central notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) specifically concentrated at the extreme distal tips, creating a ragged edge profile.
